newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ARCO share target $136.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ARCO share target $136.

text.p: -- Shares in Atlantic Richfield Co have the potential to appreciate to $136 from $129-3/4 at Thursday's close as a result of its improved production profile and recent decision to sell its 50 percent stake in Lyondell Petrochemical and its coal assets, analyst Michael Mayer said in a research note.
-- The company on Thursday told analysts that it would earn at least $2.0 billion by 2000, which Mayer said was $12.25 per share, or 20 percent more than 1996.

-- ARCO also said it would raise output by four to five percent a year compared with previous forecasts of 2.0 percent a year through to 2001, with the growth coming from known reserves. Two thirds of the increase is coming from known reserves which will come onstream earlier than expected.

-- ARCO is trading at a significant discount to its peer group and the sales and improved production outlook "should lead to better relative value for the stock", Mayer said. ((-- David Chance New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
